name: Weltschmerz
source:
A micro visual novel about two men on a mysterious train developed by tofurocks for the O2A2 (Again) Jam of 2021. Contains some point 'n click elements and three endings.

[From [url=https://tofurocks.itch.io/weltschmerz]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于神秘火车上的两个男人的微视觉小说，由tofurocks为2021年O2A2（再次）Jam开发。包含一些点击元素和三个结局。

[来自[url=https://tofurocks.itch.io/weltschmerz]Itch.io[/url]]
